meta.methodology: Properties are included only when a direct property or official tourism source can be paired with usable coordinates. Straight-line distances are calculated from the property coordinates to the reviewed border coordinates in data/borders.json; they are not road distances.
meta.availability: No live room availability is provided. Travellers must confirm dates, rates, access, parking and arrival arrangements directly with the property.
meta.parkingPolicy: Secure parking is shown only when the cited source explicitly publishes a security claim. Parking availability alone is not described as secure.
